outcome: Prevalence of antibiotic prescription fulfillment during pregnancy
Pattern of antibiotic use (monotherapy vs. multi-therapy)
cohort: The study included 67,917 pregnant women from Malopolska Voivodeship who had antibiotic prescriptions reimbursed by the Malopolska Health Fund.
finding: During pregnancy, 23.6% of women filled antibiotic prescriptions, with the lowest percentage in the first trimester (7.8%) and highest among women under 18 years of age (32.1%), and monotherapy, primarily beta-lactams, constituted 94.78% of cases.
